methods.bulk_import: a repository whose checked files share one commit date is an import rather than a history; the date is kept and labelled
methods.name: read from the strategy_id (a date, or a Unix timestamp, as written)
methods.site: WordPress REST of the published site, post slug == strategy_id

what_this_is: Real dates per strategy from three sources, with the source named: a date the file name carries (name), the published site's post date (site), and the last commit that touched the file in the repository it was harvested from (upstream). None of them is a publication date of the author's revision except where it says so. One writer: tools/source_dates.py; an emptiness is never filled in by guessing.
